reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: "Owen" (Spike Fearn) is the sound guy at a student party who meets and falls for "Emily". She is about to head off when he asks for her number, but in her haste (or perhaps deliberately?) she only gives him ten of the necessary eleven digits. He's well and truly smitten and so decides he is going to track her down. Easier said than done as there are hundreds of girls called Emily at the university. His first enquiry introduces him to one who is over from the USA (Angourie Rice) and who is in need of a special project to complete her studies and, hopefully, secure a working visa for herself. She agrees to help him, but with her own ulterior motives never far from her mind she only succeeds in making things extremely complicated for a young man whose innocent enquiry ends up seeing him swimming against a tide of angrily toxic feminity that brands him as just about everything from a pest to a pervert. Meantime, he is having to deal with selling his late mother's home he shares with his brother "Matt" (Jack Riddiford) and his girlfriend "Freya" (Isabella Laughland) and, of course, with all this publicity he can't quite fathom why the real "Emily" isn't getting in touch. Is there any chance this man is going to find his dream fairy before he gets himself further manipulated by one lass and possibly lynched by all the others? The charismatic Fearn is on good form throughout this quite entertainingly written and quickly paced comedy that isn't without it's teeth. It takes a swipe at the ridulousness of excessive political correctness; at those who take themselves far too seriously and - thanks to a few sparing but cutting contributions from Minnie Driver - at those unforgiving types who toss their grenades in first, regardless of any justification. It's good fun, this, and though perhaps a little on the long side - especially at the end - it's worth a watch.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a lovesick musician accidentally gets the wrong number for his dream girl, he partners with an ambitious psychology student to track her down, unintentionally setting off a chaotic campus-wide romance spree.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Lovesick musician Leo thinks he has finally scored a date with his ideal girl, only to realize he was given the wrong phone number. Desperate for answers, he strikes a deal with Maya, a driven psychology student who sees his romantic quest as a fascinating subject for her research on obsession. As their search escalates into a hilarious campus-wide frenzy, the unexpected duo finds their own hearts and ambitions put to the ultimate test. Ultimately, their mission to find a stranger forces them to confront what—and who—they truly want.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Leo is an idealistic campus musician whose world turns upside down after a brief, electrifying interaction with the girl of his dreams, Emily. However, when he attempts to text her later that night, he discovers he was handed a completely wrong number. Unwilling to let fate slip away, Leo crosses paths with Maya, an overachieving psychology student who agrees to help him decipher the clues and navigate the digital breadcrumbs. What starts as a simple search quickly spirals into an elaborate investigation that captures the imagination of the entire university, sparking viral social media trends and romantic chaos across campus. As Maya meticulously analyzes Leo's romantic obsession for her term paper, Leo's relentless optimism begins to break down her strictly pragmatic exterior. Together, they stage elaborate stunts and follow bizarre leads, drawing in eccentric classmates and generating widespread attention. Yet, as the relentless hunt for Emily nears its climax, the growing emotional bond between Leo and Maya becomes impossible to ignore. Facing the reality of their journey, both must decide whether to continue pursuing an elusive ideal or embrace the genuine connection right in front of them.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Finding Emily follows Leo, a passionate campus musician whose life takes an unexpected turn after a chance encounter with a girl named Emily. After accidentally receiving a wrong phone number, Leo refuses to give up on love and enlists the help of Maya, a sharp and pragmatic psychology major who uses his romantic quest as real-world data for her research. As their frantic search gains traction, it triggers a hilarious, university-wide spectacle that engages students across campus. Amidst the mounting chaos, Leo and Maya navigate the absurdities of modern dating, forcing both to re-evaluate their personal ambitions and what love truly means.
